execution_trust.boundary_scope: integrity and accidental-bypass guard only; Python code in the same process is not a hostile security boundary

problem: P1 ocean temperature quality-control anomaly detection
hypothesis: A high-capacity, full-14-day-receptive-field MS-TCN++/ASRF model can recover long offset, drift, and noise events missed by the exact current Router. The candidate is an anchor-preserving union, so the challenger cannot remove an incumbent positive.

round_b_oof.role: research lineage only; not the Q2 selection anchor

current_router_oof_anchor.role: primary anchor for every Q2/Q3/Q4 union metric

selection_rationale.reason_for_p1_priority: P1 has substantially more identifiable recoverable error than the locally plausible P2/P3 deltas, and the incumbent-preserving union bounds the main downside to newly added false positives.
selection_rationale.difference_from_prior_deep_failures: Prior P1 TCNs had only about 29-31 rows of effective receptive field or tiny 64-dimensional transformers selected after 1-3 epochs. The dual-dilated prediction generator has a 3969-row theoretical receptive field and therefore covers the complete 2048-row window, then refines predictions three times and learns explicit event boundaries.

primary_sources.claim: multi-stage dilated temporal convolutions iteratively refine dense temporal predictions and smoothing loss reduces fragmentation
primary_sources.title: MS-TCN: Multi-Stage Temporal Convolutional Network for Action Segmentation

primary_sources.claim: dual-dilated prediction generation combines short and long temporal scales before refinement stages
primary_sources.title: MS-TCN++: Multi-Stage Temporal Convolutional Network for Action Segmentation

primary_sources.claim: a dedicated boundary-regression branch can refine framewise temporal segmentation
primary_sources.title: Alleviating Over-Segmentation Errors by Detecting Action Boundaries

primary_sources.claim: time-preserving out-of-sample evaluation is preferable for nonstationary time-series model selection
primary_sources.title: Evaluating time series forecasting models: an empirical study on performance estimation methods

data_contract.segment_break: station/year/layer change or timestamp difference not exactly ten minutes
data_contract.numeric_input: 74 projected numeric features plus one finite/missing flag per feature; cached nominal_depth_m, plateau_full_length, and plateau_count are never read
data_contract.categorical_input: train-only station/layer one-hot plus a depth token derived from current-row depth_raw using train-only 33/67-percentile thresholds; cached full-year depth_regime is never read; unseen categories are all-zero
data_contract.boundary_target: start and end Gaussian bands with sigma 3 rows

cached_feature_dependency_audit.bounded_future_policy: allowed only when actual train-to-holdout separation exceeds train future support 168h plus holdout past support 169h; 504h10m leaves about 167h10m slack
cached_feature_dependency_audit.unbounded_causal_past_state: plateau_elapsed is past-only and deployment-available; it is not assigned a finite lookback bound
cached_feature_dependency_audit.cached_temporal_grouping: cached has_gap_before groups station/layer while runtime windows group station/year/layer; it is retained only as one-step past key metadata and a separate runtime station/year/layer gap channel is always added
cached_feature_dependency_audit.depth_policy: recompute split-locally from current-row depth_raw with thresholds fit only on that phase's training rows

chronological_q2_qualification.model_context_not_added_to_purge_reason: train and validation RowSurface objects are split before independent SegmentLayout/window construction, so no model input window can cross the split
fit_order: fit train-only preprocessing separately for the pre-Q2 prefix
train both registered widths with all three seeds for all 300 epochs
seal every registered width/checkpoint/threshold three-seed-mean Q2 candidate before opening Q2 truth
select one current-Router-OR recipe on Q2 and treat Q2 as selection-only
fresh-refit the frozen recipe independently for Q3 and Q4
seal both confirmatory candidates before computing either Q3 or Q4 metric

q3.membership_semantics: frozen series-local chronological fold; exact-key disjoint from Q4; its global envelope overlaps the Q4 KST calendar-day cross-section on 2025-10-01

q4.membership_semantics: frozen series-local chronological fold; exact-key disjoint from Q3; global calendar overlap is handled by pooled whole-day bootstrap sampling

truth_open_order: commit every preregistered Q2 width/epoch/representation/threshold blind candidate
open Q2 truth once and select one recipe
fresh-refit and commit Q3 blind from the pre-Q3 historical prefix
fresh-refit and commit Q4 blind from the pre-Q4 historical prefix, which legitimately includes now-historical Q3 labels; same-fold Q4 holdout truth remains closed
compute no Q3 metric or gate before both Q3 and Q4 blind receipts and score arrays verify
open Q3 and Q4 scoring views only after both blind receipts verify

windowing.short_segment_policy: right zero padding with valid mask
windowing.training_positive_windows: all windows intersecting any positive run
windowing.negative_selection: fixed SHA256 rank from seed and window identity

architecture.normalization: none; residual Conv-ReLU-1x1 blocks follow the MS-TCN++ topology

pre_fit_gpu_throughput_calibration.measurement_scope: exact label-free input-width165 calibration pinned by capacity_calibration_receipt; width256/batch128 shown here, width512/batch64 is pinned in the same receipt
pre_fit_gpu_throughput_calibration.selection_reason: batch128 had the best measured samples/second among 64/96/128 and retains about 14GB physical headroom on the 32GB device

prediction_representation.selection_unit: three-seed ensemble-mean raw probabilities, never an individual seed
prediction_representation.ema_0_999_rejected_reason: batch128 gives about five optimizer steps per epoch, leaving about 22 percent random-initialization weight after 300 epochs

checkpoint_and_threshold_selection.weights_for_scientific_selection: raw three-seed ensemble mean committed blind on Q2
checkpoint_and_threshold_selection.candidate_count_formula: 2 widths * 63 epochs * 7 thresholds * 1 raw three-seed ensemble representation
checkpoint_and_threshold_selection.q2_multiple_selection_interpretation: optimistic tuning evidence only; never confirmatory promotion evidence

convergence_receipt.selected_before_300_interpretation: selection evidence only; no convergence claim

training.event_positive_weight: each phase-training negative/positive row ratio clipped to [1, 20] and recomputed only from that phase's historical training prefix

type_posterior_integration.reason: the subtype head is conditional auxiliary evidence, so it mildly ranks eligible event rows instead of acting as an independent normal/event gate

implementation_sanity_gate.sample: first 32 windows intersecting an offset/drift/noise run of at least 19 rows and first 32 normal pre-Q2 windows by registered deterministic rank
implementation_sanity_gate.evaluation_weights: raw weights to prevent EMA initialization lag from creating a false implementation failure

q2_continuation_gate.role: continuation gate after optimistic finite-grid selection; never promotion evidence
q2_continuation_gate.long_event_recall_definition: row-weighted recall on rows belonging to maximal exact-cadence label-positive runs of at least 19 rows that contain offset, drift, or noise; no truth-run upper cap; evaluated on identical Q2 rows for anchor and candidate
q2_continuation_gate.decoder_eligible_oracle_receipt_after_tr: report FN rows in events at least 19 rows long, wholly missed versus boundary-partial, by duration band/type/station; decoder has no upper duration cap and this diagnostic is not a tuning surface
q2_continuation_gate.normal_false_positive_ratio_definition: candidate false-positive rows divided by anchor false-positive rows on the identical Q2 population; if anchor FP is zero, candidate FP must also be zero
q2_continuation_gate.failure_action: NO_GO_Q2; do not run Q3/Q4 fresh refits

confirmatory_gate.primary_population: pooled Q3+Q4 only; Q2 is excluded because it selected width/epoch/threshold
confirmatory_gate.bootstrap_population: concatenate exact keywise-disjoint Q3+Q4 rows, aggregate each KST calendar-day cross-section once, then run one pooled 21-day circular moving-block bootstrap; the shared 2025-10-01 calendar day is never independently duplicated by fold

high_impact_official_probe.interpretation: eligible for one separately authorized official probe; not proof of plus three official points

confirmatory_gate.official_three_point_claim_rule: only an official result with P1 F1 at least 0.930749 may support the approximate plus-three-points claim
